author: Josan
description: A festive Indian drink made with milk and a rich blend of nuts and spices — traditionally served during Holi and Maha Shivratri.
instructions: Grind almonds, cashews, melon seeds, fennel, peppercorns, and cardamom into a fine paste using a little milk.
In a bowl, mix this paste with chilled milk and sugar. Add saffron and rose water.
Stir well or blend lightly for a smoother consistency.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes to let flavors infuse (optional).
Strain if desired, then serve chilled with saffron strands or crushed nuts on top.
